text: {"ok": false, "issues": ["requirement says termination notices must be filed with LAHD 'within 3 business days of service', but the source (D043) says a copy must be filed 'no later than 3 days after it is served'. The source does not say business days."], "fix": {"requirement": "Tenancies in RSO units may be ended only for legal at-fault or no-fault reasons. For a no-fault eviction the landlord must first file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD, then give the required written notice and pay relocation assistance within 15 days of serving notice (or place it in escrow); a copy of the notice must be filed with LAHD no later than 3 days after service."}}
